verdict.rationale: Notte documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents start cloud browser sessions, interact with pages, fetch data and build scripts. Integration guides show CrewAI and Vercel AI SDK agents connecting to it, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Give your AI agents access to the entire Notte ecosystem. Notte MCP lets it start cloud browser sessions, interact with the pages, fetch data, build scripts, and more.
Point its MCP client at the Notte MCP server and your TypeScript agent gets a browser.
pointing it at the Notte MCP server hands your crew a real browser.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.notte.cc/mcp-server
